publicSurfaceDiscovery.result: A current official Charge-IT/LichtBlick public ad-hoc entry point was found. The legacy Charge-IT direct-charging page redirects to a current Linktree whose first official action is Online-Direktbezahlung at payments.lichtblick-emobility.de. The payment landing page is public, but this pass did not expose a stable documented query/API contract for retrieving a station tariff without a station identifier. Therefore the family remains suitable for evidence-led per-EVSE probing, but no private endpoint is guessed or reverse-engineered.
publicSurfaceDiscovery.retryGuard: One public-surface probe completed. A second probe is allowed only with a concrete station/EVSE identifier or QR/direct-payment URL shape. Do not repeat generic endpoint guessing.

resolvedFromFamily.name: Stadtwerke Greifswald GmbH
resolvedFromFamily.why: The CPO's own current page already publishes a complete direct/ad-hoc normal-public-estate matrix, making backend extraction unnecessary: 0.50 EUR/kWh AC plus 0.10 EUR/min blocking from minute 241, with direct credit-card charging without registration.

remainingConfirmedCpos.name: Stadtwerke Einbeck GmbH
remainingConfirmedCpos.evidence: Current tourism/Stadtwerke-supplied station pages confirm charge it easy can be used without registration and paid by credit card. Current secondary station records report 0.49 EUR/kWh AC / 0.64 EUR/kWh DC, but exact direct fee completeness and authoritative estate-wide equivalence remain unproven.
remainingConfirmedCpos.next: Use a concrete Einbeck EVSE/QR/direct-payment identifier to query the public LichtBlick payment surface; otherwise reconcile current per-EVSE records from Mobilithek/AFIR.

remainingConfirmedCpos.name: Stadtwerke Bad Kissingen GmbH
remainingConfirmedCpos.evidence: Current first-party page confirms charge it easy ad-hoc without registration and credit-card payment, but its numeric tariff table is explicitly dated 15.06.2021; Parkhaus Zentrum is currently unavailable.
remainingConfirmedCpos.next: Do not ingest the 2021 numeric table as current. Query current direct-payment conditions for the active KissSalis/Tattersall/Kaserne points or obtain current authoritative per-EVSE records.

remainingConfirmedCpos.name: FAMILA public charging network
remainingConfirmedCpos.evidence: Charge-IT/charge it easy relationship is confirmed at multiple FAMILA sites, but current direct prices are site/class-variable and operator/brand ownership requires reconciliation. Current station evidence includes a Weyhe example at 0.29 EUR/kWh AC and 0.48 EUR/kWh DC; this is station-scoped only and must not be generalized.
remainingConfirmedCpos.next: Reconcile FAMILA physical operator/EVSE identities first, then bind direct prices per EVSE/site.

safetyRules: no tariff generalization across Charge-IT/LichtBlick customers
registered/card/roaming tariffs stay separate from anonymous direct charging
nextSafeAction: Obtain one concrete current Einbeck station identifier/QR path and perform the second and final evidence-led public-payment probe.
